name: techdella/ad-mock
title: Ad mock
description: One ad creative mock in HTML/CSS: TikTok (9:16), Instagram (1:1), Meta feed, LinkedIn (1.91:1 or document ad), Google search, Google display, plus reel, carousel, video and motion tiles. Carries a visible "Example" label unless it is a live client ad.

attributes.overlay: POV: your ads finally pay back
attributes.headline: @yourco · Sponsored
attributes.text: We tested 12 hooks. Here’s what worked.

techdella.help: Fictional brand only (YourCo / Northwind) unless liveClientAd is on — tick it only for a real client ad with written permission; it removes the "Example" label (§2.3). Fields by format: headline, text, overlay (text on the image), cta, footer (bottom note), tag (top pill, e.g. "Reel · 0:15"), query (Google search), sitelinks ["Pricing"], slides [{label, title}] (carousel).
